Times of Israel liveblog, 22 October 2026 (times Israel, BST = -2h)

11:17 am — IRGC threatens to hit American bases in region if US keeps escorting ships through Hormuz
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps threatened to target U.S. military installations across the Middle East if Washington continues escorting vessels through the Strait of Hormuz. "The US military must know that if this trend continues, the conflict will extend to its bases in the region."
Iran asserts control over Hormuz, a critical waterway handling roughly one-fifth of global oil transit before recent hostilities commenced. U.S. naval forces have escalated escort operations through the waterway. Four vessels sustained damage overnight as they attempted passage through the broader Gulf region, according to Iranian military statements. Washington simultaneously maintains a naval embargo on Iranian ports, while diplomatic negotiations remain deadlocked.

11:47 am — Israel said to give US intel that Hamas has no plans to disarm, is prepping for new war
Per Haaretz reporting: IDF believes Hamas restored its tunnel infrastructure, accumulated munitions, and maintains between 30,000-40,000 operatives — matching pre-October 7, 2023 strength. US-coordinated negotiations on Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal have stalled.

12:11 pm — UN's Albanese says Indonesia should rethink membership in Board of Peace
Francesca Albanese: "I understand (Indonesia's) good intentions. I still think that it's very dangerous, because it risks normalizing a very abnormal mechanism."

12:12 pm — Top European, Mideast diplomats to meet in Istanbul tomorrow, with Palestinian issue on agenda

9:39 am — Eisenkot (Yashar): Katz "preparing the ground for the next disaster and shifting blame in advance"; "Our army is strong, but our leadership is rotten and dangerous."
9:18 am — Lapid: Katz's statement is "gift to Israel's enemies."
